title: Tamil Poet R. Vairamuthu Conferred 60th Jnanpith Award (2025)
summary: Becomes 3rd Tamil author to receive India's highest literary honour.

blocks.content: Becomes 3rd Tamil author to receive India's highest literary honour.

items: 60th Jnanpith Awardee: Renowned Tamil poet and lyricist R. Vairamuthu.
Previous Winners: 59th Vinod Kumar Shukla (Hindi); 58th Gulzar (Urdu) & Rambhadracharya (Sanskrit).
